description: Sfingi — Colore: White, tan & black Codice: 5116 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Large Altezza: 141 cm Rapporto: 134 cm × 175 cm Toni: Black The Sphinx motif in SFINGI is a festive interpretation of French Directoire style, a transitional period between Louis XVI and Empire style popularized in post-revolutionary France. Whimsical and imaginative, SFINGI’s field is dressed with ribbons, swag, and tassels, strewn around floral urns and vases, and of course, the enigmatic Sphinx. These popular motifs from antiquity, especially Greek and Pompeian ornamentation, heavily influenced the French Directoire style.
